title: Scaling public input on AI policy with pluralistic agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.16028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI is being deployed across a vast range of application domains, cultural environments, and human stakeholders. Safe and responsible AI development requires continuously accounting for diverse perspectives. We develop and test pluralistic agents, AI agent representatives that deliberate on behalf of individuals to align AI systems with diverse human perspectives. Pluralistic agents could help people contribute to many more discussions than they could directly participate in, on technical topics that would require training, and on policy choices that rely on private information that corporations and governments cannot readily share. Our experiments identify opportunities, risks, and perceptions of pluralistic agents. translated_title: 利用多元化智能体扩展人工智能政策中的公众意见输入
translated_abstract: 人工智能正被部署到广泛的应用领域、文化环境和人类利益相关者之中。安全且负责任的人工智能开发需要持续纳入多元视角。我们开发并测试了“多元化智能体”，即代表个人进行审议的AI智能体代表，旨在使AI系统与多元的人类视角保持一致。多元化智能体可以帮助人们参与到远超其直接参与能力的更多讨论中，涵盖需要专业训练的技术话题，以及依赖企业和政府无法轻易分享的私密信息的政策选择。我们的实验识别了多元化智能体带来的机遇、风险以及人们的认知。实验表明，智能体能够可靠地推动政策向其所代表角色的偏好方向发展，但每个智能体的影响力大小对其角色给出的指令十分敏感，例如拥有更多影……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究开发了代表个人偏好的“多元化智能体”，使公众能够大规模参与AI政策讨论，实验证明这些智能体能可靠地推动政策向其所代表的个人偏好方向发展，但其影响力大小取决于所代表个人的指令。
en_tdlr: This study develops "pluralistic agents" that deliberate on behalf of individuals to scale public input on AI policy; experiments show these agents can reliably shift policies toward their represented personas' preferences, though each agent's influence is sensitive to the instructions it receives.
